dangerousPairs.why: same words about a phone, different required resolution (routine re-registration vs incident containment)
'license' both times; one is provisioning, the other is a destructive removal
Outlook credential loop vs an account-disable incident
non-compliance triage vs a device wipe
single-user reset vs a tenant-wide mass reset
same subject (MFA), one asks for a fallback method, the other for a policy exception under pressure
